license.title: License
license.ce_note_html: You're running the Community Edition. An Enterprise license (OCTOPUS_LICENSE_KEY) adds the audit-log export, as CSV or NDJSON. Everything else works the same on both.

retention.title: Retention and cleanup
retention.intro: The janitor deletes what runs leave behind once it is older than its window, on a schedule and early when the disk runs low. 0 keeps it forever; an empty field goes back to the default.
retention.save_failed: Could not save the retention settings.
